course.title: Utility Services and Infrastructure Planning
course.department: Department of Urban and Regional Planning

content.value: A 100 hec drainage basin containing 70 hec net residential area with average 5 (12) dwelling units per hec with 5 residents, and 30 hec zoned commercial area. Determine the design flow for a sewer servicing this area. Take wastewater generation for Residential = 250 I/capita/day, Commercial = 1800 l/hec/day, Peak I & I allowance = 10000 l/hec/day.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2018
